questions.text: Design Amazon's product catalog pipeline — ingest from millions of third-party sellers, normalize and validate, and serve to search and recommendations. Handle schema inconsistencies, duplicates, and malicious sellers.
Your EMR job that processes daily order data is suddenly running 3x longer than baseline. Walk me through your investigation and remediation process.
Given a list of orders with customer_id, product_id, and timestamp, find all customers who purchased the same product within 24 hours of each other (for fraud detection).
Tell me about a time you took ownership of a problem that was outside your defined scope. What was the situation and what did you do?
Describe a time you had to make a significant technical decision with incomplete information. How did you decide what to do?

experiences.notes: Every round had 2 LP questions minimum. Bar Raiser asked for very specific numbers and challenged 'we improved performance' with 'how do you know it was your change?'. STAR format strictly enforced.
